12: theorem List.subset_append_cons_right {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] {a b c : List α} {x : α}
13:   (h : a ⊆ (b ++ c)) : a ⊆ b ++ (x :: c) := by
14:   simp_all [List.instHasSubset, List.Subset]
15:   intro e he
16:   have := @h e he
17:   cases this <;> simp_all
18:   done
19: 
20: /--
21: Remove duplicates in a list.
22: -/
23: def dedup {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] : List α → List α
24:   | [] => []
25:   | a :: as =>
26:     let as := as.dedup
27:     if a ∈ as then as else a :: as
28: 
29: /--
30: A deduplicated list satisfies `Nodup`.
31: -/
32: theorem nodup_dedup {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) :
33:   l.dedup.Nodup := by
34:   induction l with
35:   | nil => simp [dedup]
36:   | cons a as ih =>
37:     simp [dedup]
38:     split
39:     · exact ih
40:     · rename_i h; constructor
41:       · exact fun a' a_1 => Ne.symm (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem a_1 h)
42:       · exact ih
43: 
44: /--
45: The upper bound of the length of a deduplicated list is the length of the
46: original list.
47: -/
48: theorem length_dedup_le {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) :
49:   l.dedup.length ≤ l.length := by
50:   induction l with
51:   | nil => simp [dedup]
52:   | cons a as ih =>
53:     simp [dedup]
54:     split
55:     · exact Nat.le_succ_of_le ih
56:     · simp; exact ih
57: 
58: /--
59: The lower bound of the length of a deduplicated list with an element consed onto
60: it (i.e., `(a :: l)`) is the length of the deduplicated list `l`.
61: -/
62: theorem length_dedup_cons_le {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (a : α) (l : List α) :
63:   l.dedup.length ≤ (a :: l).dedup.length := by
64:   induction l with
65:   | nil => simp [dedup]
66:   | cons a as ih =>
67:     simp [dedup]
68:     split
69:     · exact ih
70:     · rename_i a' h
71:       simp_all
72:       by_cases a' = a
73:       · simp_all
74:       · by_cases a' ∈ as.dedup <;> simp_all
75: 
76: theorem mem_dedup_of_mem {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
77:   (l : List α) (a : α) : a ∈ l.dedup → a ∈ l := by
78:   induction l with
79:   | nil => simp [dedup]
80:   | cons b bs ih =>
81:     simp [dedup]
82:     split
83:     · intro h
84:       exact Or.symm (Or.intro_left (a = b) (ih h))
85:     · intro h
86:       cases h with
87:       | head => exact Or.symm (Or.inr rfl)
88:       | tail _ h' => exact Or.symm (Or.intro_left (a = b) (ih h'))
89: 
90: theorem mem_of_mem_dedup {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
91:   (l : List α) (a : α) : a ∈ l → a ∈ l.dedup := by
92:   induction l with
93:   | nil => simp [dedup]
94:   | cons b bs ih =>
95:     simp [dedup]
96:     intro h; cases h
97:     · subst a
98:       by_cases b ∈ bs.dedup <;> simp_all
99:     · by_cases b ∈ bs.dedup <;> simp_all
